name: @reelsfarm/mcp-client
stderr:
Usage: reelsfarm [options] [command]

CLI for the ReelsFarm MCP SDK

Options:
  --json                    print JSON output
  --agent                   print strict agent-ready JSON envelopes
  --server-url <url>        MCP server URL
  --allow-insecure-http     allow a trusted non-loopback HTTP MCP endpoint
  --api-key <key>           ReelsFarm MCP API key
  --profile <name>          credential profile (default: "default")
  --wait                    wait for async job completion
  --timeout <ms>            timeout in milliseconds
  --dry-run                 prepare actions without confirming them
  --yes                     automatically confirm Review-mode prepared actions
  --idempotency-key <key>   stable key to reuse when retrying one logical
                            mutation
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]
  logout
  whoami
  account
  avatars
  product-scenes
  hooks
  videos
  slideshows
  image-generations
  ai-clones
  media-collections
  community
  product-contexts
  trash
  social
  posts
  assets
  automations
  events
  validate
  confirm <confirmationId>
  operations
  agent
  completion [shell]
  help [command]            display help for command
